title: Local Resilience for Containment of Bounded Degree Spanning Subgraphs
summary: We prove that for all $Δ\geq 2$ and $γ> 0$, there exists a constant $C = C(Δ, γ)$ such that for $p\geq C(\log n/n)^{1/Δ}$, asymptotically almost surely, every spanning subgraph $G$ of $G(n,p)$ with minimum degree at least $(1-1/(2Δ)+γ)pn$ contains every $n$-vertex graph $H$ with maximum degree at most $Δ$ and with at least $Cp^{-2}$ vertices not in any triangles of $H$. This is a 'sparse local resilience version' of a classical theorem of Sauer and Spencer.
